clear_bug_fix.notes: Clear focused repairs often benefit from solo execution with optional targeted specialist help.

broad_unknown_build.notes: Broad unknown builds often benefit from phased specialist involvement rather than full early fan-out.

complex_architecture_work.notes: Architecture-heavy work often benefits from pair-style design review before broader execution.

multi-surface_delivery.notes: Multi-surface work benefits from sequencing first, then selective team expansion once interfaces stabilize.

research_to_build.notes: Research-to-build missions often benefit from bounded solo discovery before specialist implementation help.
